scope: 8 uniformly indexed old observations per old scene, both bowls; numerical geometry oracle only
observations: 8 identity-labelled projections of fixed farthest-sampled mesh vertices; generated using GT pose for oracle annotation only
solver_inputs: known scaled mesh vertex coordinates, pixel correspondences, calibrated camera; no GT depth/translation/rotation initial guess
method: EPNP then ITERATIVE refinement with EPNP estimate
limitations: Does not establish visibility or natural identifiability of these vertices on near-axisymmetric bowls; cannot count as deployable accuracy
